statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ledger" ("account" text COLLATE "C", "amount" bigint, "memo" text COLLATE "C", "posted" date, PRIMARY KEY ("account", "posted"))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "ledger_amount" ON "ledger" ("amount")
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "ledger_memo" ON "ledger" ("memo" COLLATE "C", "amount")
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "ledger_posted_brin" ON "ledger" USING brin ("posted")
why: A B-tree renders with no USING clause, whether the method is absent or written out, and its text column with the reads' collation; BRIN renders USING brin. Statements in code point order of the index name, and the document lists them out of order.
The same layout through the ClickHouse renderer is refused: it has no B-tree and no BRIN, and its primary index is ORDER BY.
